primary_replacement_minimum.count: Weeks with scored eligible outcomes; training/folds/seeds/output views/other procedures do not count.
primary_replacement_minimum.window: All qualifying weeks, never best five; retain 2026 W1-8 primary and each older season separately.
primary_replacement_minimum.chronology: Earlier-only fits/features/preprocessing/calibration/selectors; declared rolling refit permitted; outcome holdout differs from model-selection exposure.
primary_replacement_minimum.retrospective: Compatible historical tests can count for the existing policy's provisional uses; source/quote uncertainty does not become original pregame evidence.
primary_replacement_minimum.products: Projection, expected mean, actual-line direction, probability and Top Picks are separate qualification cells.
primary_replacement_minimum.shadow: Fewer than five weeks may be shadow-captured but not presented as qualified primary replacements.
primary_replacement_minimum.other_requirements: Five weeks alone establishes neither useful coverage nor superiority; preserve rights, support, source, scientific and operational requirements.

A_diagnosis: Audit saved volume/share/other/participation/position/fallback conservation on identical supported games; component substitution is postgame and non-deployable. At most one subsequent justified mechanism, registered after diagnosis and evaluated later without retuning.
B_C_ownership: B diagnoses confidence/selection; C traces information fields and maintains the one shared qualification table; consume their authenticated contributions rather than duplicate runs.

Count_A_priority.required: Authenticate exact model, trained prior-mean corrector and feature/source bindings; retained/current-adapter parity; real source/issue/persistence clocks; side/role/ranking/fallback/expiry and permitted producer publication plus consumer receipt.
Count_A_priority.columns: FORECASTS.parquet.point is corrected; legacy_point remains mixed; mean is NaN. Bare predict is not the complete mean procedure.
Count_A_priority.state_route: NFL-forecasting lab-state / state/public/weekly-adaptive-v1/2026-W09 is a recorded route to inspect, not a fixed future execution date or proof of model absence.

capture: Existing authorized owner and scheduler only; genuine permitted future cutoffs; preserve forecast-only capture when offers fail qualification. No backfill, new scheduler or assumed execution.
prohibited: Paid acquisition, credit spending, credentials/permissions changes, competing producers/evaluators/schedulers, external messages outside existing authorized handoff routes, wagers, erased failures, automatic failed-wave promotion or probability/EV inference from a point.
